units.source_text: 老尼姑弁君想，薰大将处也得去探望一下，便走过去。

en.t: The old nun Ben no Kimi thought that she ought to go and look in on Captain Kaoru as well, so she walked over to his rooms.

units.source_text: 薰大将的随从人等机敏地回报她道：“大人身体有些不适，此刻正在休息。”

en.t: Kaoru's attendants answered her tactfully, saying, "His lordship is feeling a little unwell and is resting just now."

units.source_text: 弁君想道：“他以前说过要找寻这个人，大约今天想乘此机会和她会面，所以在那里等待日暮吧。”

en.t: Ben no Kimi thought, "He once said he wanted to find this woman; perhaps today he means to use this chance to meet her, and is waiting there until nightfall."

units.source_text: 她不知他正在洞隙里窥看呢。

en.t: She did not know that he was already peering through a crack.

units.source_text: 薰大将领地中庄院里的人，照例送些装盒子的食品来，弁君那里也有一份。

en.t: People from one of Kaoru's estates had, as usual, sent boxed foods, and there was a portion for Ben no Kimi too.

units.source_text: 弁君想请东国来的人们也吃些，以表示招待，便整理一下衣饰，来到客人室中。

en.t: Wanting to offer some of it to the people who had come from the eastern provinces as a gesture of hospitality, Ben no Kimi straightened her clothing and went into the guest room.

units.source_text: 那老侍女所称赞的装束，果然非常整洁，相貌也很端正清秀。

en.t: The attire that the old waiting woman had praised was indeed very neat, and the young lady's features were refined and clear.

units.source_text: 弁君开言道：“我道小姐昨天可到，等候了多时。

en.t: Ben no Kimi began, "I thought the young lady might arrive yesterday, and I waited for quite a long time.

units.source_text: 为什么到今天这么晚的时候才来呢？”

en.t: Why have you come only now, so late today?"

units.source_text: 那老侍女答道：“我家小姐途中疲劳得很，昨天在木津川那边泊宿了一宵。

en.t: The old waiting woman answered, "My young mistress was greatly fatigued on the journey, and last night she stayed over near the Kizu River.

units.source_text: 今天早晨是否可以登程，也踌躇了好久，所以到得晚了。”

en.t: This morning, too, we hesitated for a long while over whether she could set out, and so we arrived late."

units.source_text: 便催小姐起身。

en.t: Then she urged the young lady to sit up.

units.source_text: 小姐好容易坐了起来，看见了这老尼姑，觉得难为情，把脸转向一旁。

en.t: The young lady managed at last to sit up, but when she saw the old nun she felt embarrassed and turned her face aside.

units.source_text: 从薰大将这边望去，正好看得清楚。

en.t: From where Captain Kaoru was watching, she could be seen quite clearly.

units.source_text: 但见她的眉目与垂发的确非常优雅。

en.t: He could see that her brows, eyes, and falling hair were truly very elegant.

units.source_text: 薰大将对已故的大女公子的相貌虽然不曾仔细端详过，但一见此人，便觉完全肖似，回忆前尘，不禁又掉下泪来。

en.t: Although Captain Kaoru had never looked closely at the late elder princess's face, the moment he saw this woman he felt she was exactly like her; remembering the past, he could not help shedding tears again.

units.source_text: 小姐对弁君答话，声音很轻，然而很像匂亲王夫人的声音。

en.t: When the young lady answered Ben no Kimi, her voice was very soft, yet it sounded much like the voice of Prince Niou's wife.

units.source_text: 薰大将想道：“唉，多么可爱的人啊！

en.t: Captain Kaoru thought, "Ah, what a dear and lovely person she is!

units.source_text: 世间有这等肖似的人，而我一向不知，实在太荒唐了。

en.t: For there to be someone in the world so much like her, while I knew nothing of it all this time, is truly absurd.

units.source_text: 只要是与大女公子有关的人，即使身份比此人更低，倘如此酷肖乃姊，我也不会轻易放过。

en.t: If a person had any connection with the elder princess, even someone of lower rank than this, I would never lightly let her pass by if she so closely resembled her sister.

units.source_text: 何况此人虽然不蒙八亲王认领，到底确是他的亲生女儿。”

en.t: And this woman, though Prince Hachi never acknowledged her, is after all certainly his own daughter."

units.source_text: 这样一想，便觉无限可爱，无限可喜。

en.t: Thinking this, he found her endlessly lovable and felt boundless joy.

units.source_text: 又想：“我恨不得现在就走到她面前，对她说道：‘原来你还活在世间！’这才可慰我心。

en.t: He thought further, "I long to go to her at once and say, 'So you were still alive in this world after all!' Only that would comfort my heart.

units.source_text: 玄宗皇帝叫方士寻到了蓬莱岛上，只取得些钗钿回来，毕竟是不满意的吧。

en.t: When Emperor Xuanzong sent a Taoist master to seek her on Mount Penglai, he must surely have been unsatisfied with receiving only a few hair ornaments in return.

units.source_text: 此人虽然不是大女公子本人，然而非常肖似，可慰我心。”

en.t: Though this woman is not the elder princess herself, she resembles her so closely that she can comfort my heart."

units.source_text: 大约他和此人宿缘甚深。

en.t: Perhaps the bond from a previous life between him and this woman was very deep.

units.source_text: 老尼姑略谈一会，不久就告辞回内室去。

en.t: The old nun talked for a little while, then soon took her leave and returned to the inner room.

units.source_text: 两侍女闻到香气，弁君明知是薰大将在近处窥看之故。

en.t: The two waiting women noticed the fragrance, and Ben no Kimi knew perfectly well that it was because Captain Kaoru was watching nearby.

units.source_text: 大约因此她不再多谈，就退出了。

en.t: Probably for that reason, she said no more and withdrew.
